What if every human got a random superpower overnight?
You wake up.
Your hands feel warm… too warm.
Then.
Over eight billion people get a power at the exact same second.
Your neighbor floats above the roof.
A child makes the streetlights flicker.
Some powers are amazing.
Others are useless… like glowing in the dark.
And nobody can control them.
Traffic stops.
Nobody knows who is dangerous.
But here's the twist.
Some humans already have something like superpowers.
The Bajau sea nomads have spleens about fifty percent bigger than nearby non-divers, which may help them stay underwater longer.
A rare change in a single gene means some people feel no pain at all.
And some women have a fourth type of color cone.
A few may see colors we can't.
So remember.
Superpowers might already be hiding in our genes.
Which one would you want?
